spec.title: Add + button to directives in VSCode plugin similar to TASKS which triggers festina-directive
spec.context: The DIRECTIVES section in the VSCode extension lacks a quick way to create new directives. Users must manually create directive XML files or use the command palette, unlike TASKS and QUICKS sections which have convenient [+] header buttons. This task adds a [+] button to the DIRECTIVES header that runs /festina-directive in the terminal, providing consistent UX across all sections.

in-scope.item: Add [+] button to DIRECTIVES section header
Wire terminal orchestrator to directives orchestrator

out-of-scope.item: Adding search or refresh buttons to DIRECTIVES (may be future enhancement)
Changing how existing directive items display

requirements.requirement: The system shall display a [+] button in the DIRECTIVES section header when .festinalente folder exists
The system shall register a festinalente.createDirective command with title "Festina Lente: Create Directive" and add icon
The system shall execute /festina-directive in terminal when the button is clicked
The button shall appear at navigation@1 position (leftmost, matching TASKS pattern)

files.file: Add command definition and view/title menu contribution
Add terminal dependency, register createDirective command
Pass terminal orchestrator to directives orchestrator

patterns.pattern: Command defined in package.json contributes.commands with icon $(add). Menu contribution in view/title with when clause "view == festinalenteDirectives && festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder". apps/vscode/package.json:96-98, 144-149
Commands registered in orchestrator's registerCommands method, using deps.terminal.executeInTerminal for terminal execution. apps/vscode/src/orchestrators/tasks.orchestrator.ts:264-277
Terminal orchestrator passed as dependency to domain orchestrators that need to execute commands. apps/vscode/src/orchestrators/tasks.orchestrator.ts:26-29

product.item: TASKS and QUICKS headers have [+][refresh][search] buttons. DIRECTIVES currently only displays workflows with directives, no header actions.

engineering.item: Four-layer architecture: Composition Root, Orchestrators, Capabilities, Computers. Terminal orchestrator handles command execution.

codebase.item: directives.orchestrator.ts (125 lines) - currently has no terminal dependency or command registration

item.mitigation: Follow exact TASKS/QUICKS pattern for menu contribution and command registration
Unlike TASKS/QUICKS, directive skill handles Q&A itself - just execute /festina-directive directly

constraints.constraint: Must use $(add) icon for consistency with TASKS and QUICKS
Must only show button when festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder context is true
No prompt for title - /festina-directive handles the entire workflow

internal.dep: /festina-directive skill - exists and handles directive creation workflow

risks.risk: Terminal orchestrator injection adds a dependency to directives orchestrator - mitigated by following established pattern from tasks orchestrator
